schema.id: Dot-joined path; unique within this file.
schema.name: Human-readable label, verbatim from the source document.
schema.axis: 'system' (content outline + Table 1), 'task' (Table 2 + competency PDF), or 'discipline' (Table 3). The three axes are independent classifications of the SAME item pool; do not add weights across axes.
schema.level: 1 = top of its axis; deeper integers are nested children.
schema.parent_id: id of parent topic, or null at axis root.
schema.weight_low: Integer low end of the published % range, or null if not published.
schema.weight_high: Integer high end of the published % range, or null if not published.
schema.weight_source: Provenance token for the weight. 'UNKNOWN' means USMLE publishes no figure at this level of the hierarchy and NO value was estimated or invented.
schema.weight_note: Prose explanation of the weight or of why it is null.
schema.examples: Verbatim example strings from the content outline. Illustrative only; the outline states 'The examples listed within the outline are just examples.'
schema.maps_to_content_outline_sections: For Table 1 groups: which content-outline sections this weighted group is believed to cover.
schema.section_mapping_confidence: 'exact_name_match' = the Table 1 label is identical to one content-outline section. 'inferred_by_name' = mapping deduced from names by this tool; USMLE does NOT publish the group-to-section mapping. 'inferred_by_name_label_narrower_than_section' = as above, AND the Table 1 label is narrower than the content-outline section name, so it is unclear whether the published range covers the whole section.

known_limitations: USMLE publishes percentages ONLY at the 11 Table 1 groups, the 4 weighted Table 2 competencies, and the 11 Table 3 disciplines. Every deeper node has weight_low/weight_high = null and weight_source = 'UNKNOWN'.
The Table 1 group -> content-outline section mapping is inferred from names. USMLE does not publish it. See section_mapping_confidence on each group.
Table 1 groups combine 2-4 content-outline sections. The published range applies to the COMBINED group; it was NOT split across member sections.
Step 1 Table 2 renders 'History/Physical Examination' and 'Diagnosis' as sub-rows of 'Patient Care: Diagnosis' with EMPTY percentage cells. Recorded as null, not as a share of 20-25%.
Table 3 discipline ranges are non-exclusive and sum to more than 100% by USMLE's own statement. They cannot be treated as a partition.
Table 2 covers only 4 of the 7 competencies in the competency PDF. The other 3 are included with null weights and on_step1_spec_table2 = false.

Content-outline example strings ('o' level) are attached as 'examples' and are not separate taggable topics; long example-list bullets (>60 chars with no children) are folded into the parent's 'examples' rather than becoming topics.
